mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of adding a pergola or gazebo to my backyard?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding a pergola or gazebo can significantly enhance your backyard entertaining area by providing shade, defining a space, and adding architectural interest. Pergolas offer partial shade and can be adorned with climbing plants or retractable canopies, while gazebos provide more complete shelter from sun and rain. Both create a more intimate and comfortable outdoor living environment, increasing usability and potentially property value. They serve as excellent focal points for seating or dining areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pergolas and gazebos add shade, define spaces, and create architectural interest, enhancing comfort and usability. They can increase property value and serve as focal points.
